risks.name: Creator history of rugged tokens
risks.description: Creator has a history of rugging tokens.

conclusion: Anonymous access is fast and technically available.
Fresh-token availability is inconsistent at first observation.
Material risk and LP-lock values can reverse within two minutes without an evidence timestamp or explanation.
RugCheck must not be accepted as a reliable early-token fact source for the recorder.
If retained at all, store each response as a timestamped provider opinion and never overwrite earlier snapshots.
